summary: Dirt verge beside a park on Mabel Street; homes are across the road.
reasons: Nearest home about 25 m, across road

drivers.seclusion: Open park to the north; houses to the south sit across the road and a front garden, about 25 m or more away.
drivers.access_and_room: Worn dirt verge beside the lane is wider than a van; a car is already parked on it.
drivers.traffic: Quiet local street with little through traffic seen.
drivers.convention: Cars park on the verge here, so a van would not stand out.

flags: Powerlines and a pylon cross the park just west
Low-lying: about 10 m elevation, a drain 67 m away
Mapped gates nearby all have a way round
sun_shade: Open to the sun; trees shade the park east and north-west, not the verge.

best_section.where: North side of Mabel Street on the dirt verge beside the park, just east of the creek-side junction
